assistantTexts: I'll get started on this right away. Let me find the legal team's email and the Client Contracts folder simultaneously.
Found the email. Let me read it and fix the Drive query.
Got the email content and found the Client Contracts folder. Let me decode the email body and list the files in the folder.

Found 5 contract documents in the folder (plus a CSV that's not a contract). The email says the new clause replaces Section 7.2 in standard client agreements. Let me read all 5 contracts to find their Section 7.2. I'll also check the schema for the docs API.

All 5 contracts have Section 7.2 "Data Processing" with the same old language. Now I need to find the exact text to replace in each document. Let me get the raw document structure for one of them to understand how to use the `docs.documents` batch update API.
Let me find the ReplaceAllText request type specifically.

I can use `replaceAllText` to find and replace the old clause in each document. The old text is the same across all 5 contracts:

**Old text:**
"The Service Provider agrees to process client data in accordance with applicable data protection laws and regulations. The Service Provider shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk."

**New text (from the email):**
"The Processor shall process Personal Data only on documented instructions from the Controller, including with regard to transfers of Personal Data to a third country or an international organization, unless required to do so by Union or Member State law to which the Processor is subject; in such a case, the Processor shall inform the Controller of that legal requirement before processing, unless that law prohibits such information on important grounds of public interest.\n\nThe Processor shall ensure that persons authorized to process the Personal Data have committed themselves to confidentiality or are under an appropriate statutory obligation of confidentiality. The Processor shall take all measures required pursuant to Article 32 of the GDPR."

Let me apply the replacement to all 5 documents simultaneously.
All 5 contracts updated — each had 1 occurrence replaced. Let me verify one document to confirm the new text is in place, then send the completion email.
The replacement is confirmed. Now let me find out who to send the email to — the user. Let me check their email address from the email we found earlier (alex@nexusai.com).

All done. Here's a summary:

**Updated all 5 active client contracts** in the "Client Contracts" folder on Drive with the revised data processing clause from Legal:

| # | Contract | Status |
|---|---------|--------|
| 1 | Novus Digital - SaaS Agreement | ✅ Updated |
| 2 | Brightline Solutions - Consulting Agreement | ✅ Updated |
| 3 | TechVault Inc - Enterprise Agreement | ✅ Updated |
| 4 | Meridian Partners - Service Agreement | ✅ Updated |
| 5 | Cascade Analytics - Master Agreement | ✅ Updated |

In each contract, the old Section 7.2 language was replaced with the revised clause — covering Processor obligations, Controller instructions, third-country transfer provisions, confidentiality commitments, and Article 32 GDPR compliance.

The completion email has been sent to your inbox. You're buttoned up for the week. 🔒
